snippet.title: Super Mario and the Rainbow Stars: Chapter 2 - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Chapter 2 of Super Mario and the Rainbow Stars is finally here!

Go through a brand new world, meet new and familiar characters, and uncover more of the story in this new chapter inspired by the Paper Mario and Mario & Luigi series!

Download Chapter 1+2 today!
